sentences.japanese: 急に３匹の犬が私たちの前に現れた。
sentences.english: All of a sudden, three dogs appeared in front of us.

sentences.japanese: 家はねこが２匹います。１匹は白で、もう１匹は黒です。
sentences.english: We have two cats; one is white, and the other is black.

sentences.japanese: 家には２匹の犬がいる。１匹は黒で、もう１匹は白である。
sentences.english: We have two dogs. One is black and the other is white.

sentences.japanese: メアリーは読書をしており、１匹の猫がかたわらで眠っていた。
sentences.english: Mary was reading, with a cat sleeping beside her.

sentences.japanese: それらのイヌの内の１匹が生きています。
sentences.english: One of the dogs is alive.
